name: PATN2 (blanket pattern)
summary: The second leopard-complex pattern modifier, and a pure modifier like PATN1: on an LP horse it gives the blanket patterns - a white sheet over the hips, spotted or not - and carrying both modifiers gives the semi-leopard between the two. Invisible on a horse without LP.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Carried, but silent on its own - it only shapes the pattern of a horse that also carries the leopard complex.

frequencies.population: horses without the leopard complex allele
